meaning: The body learns before the mind does
design_response: Start with a physical action before explanation

meaning: Diagrams and maps are the learner language
design_response: Use fretboard maps diagrams and node links

meaning: Needs a clear roadmap
design_response: Show current path current step and progress

meaning: Needs to know where this fits
design_response: Add a purpose card before drills

meaning: Goes to find sources independently
design_response: Offer source notes and deeper reading

meaning: Learns by trying and breaking things
design_response: Provide safe sandbox experiments

meaning: Needs processing time not more input
design_response: Offer pause revisit and reflection moments

meaning: Needs the big picture before details
design_response: Show overview before steps

meaning: Needs one piece at a time
design_response: Chunk lessons into small steps

meaning: Knows it is learned when it appears everywhere
design_response: Show where else the idea appears

meaning: Mastery means connection density
design_response: Show cross-node links and related concepts

meaning: Files ideas by category and type
design_response: Organize concepts by families and tags

meaning: Needs routine frame with choice inside
design_response: Offer a clear route with optional branches

meaning: Follows prescribed practice well
design_response: Provide clear practice cards and checklists

meaning: Repeats until clean
design_response: Use clean stop conditions and prevent overgrinding

meaning: Muscle memory feels like mastery
design_response: Track comfortable repetition not just first success

meaning: Applying elsewhere proves learning
design_response: Ask learner to use the skill in a new context

meaning: The reason drives obsession
design_response: Show why every exercise matters

meaning: Hearing or seeing improvement fuels motivation
design_response: Show visible progress and before-after evidence

meaning: Playback motivates the learner
design_response: Make recording easy and prompted

meaning: Links between ideas create energy
design_response: Surface related ideas and cross-node pathways

meaning: Small improvements matter
design_response: Name micro-wins after practice

meaning: Fun is fuel not decoration
design_response: Keep playful challenges and musical rewards

meaning: Too steep a step causes shutdown
design_response: Offer a simpler version on struggle

meaning: A missing definition can block everything after it
design_response: Ask which word went foggy and open glossary

meaning: No clear next step causes paralysis
design_response: Always show the next action

meaning: Too slow a pace causes disengagement
design_response: Offer a variation or challenge before boredom sets in

meaning: The app must help organize action
design_response: Make the next step obvious and structured

meaning: Recording is useful but easily skipped
design_response: Prompt short recordings at natural moments

meaning: Teaching is a learning tool
design_response: Add teach-back prompts and teacher prep notes

meaning: Rises when there is a real occasion
design_response: Connect tasks to upcoming lessons or performances

meaning: Learns best when it feels like play
design_response: Use games jams and low-pressure experiments

meaning: Guidance accelerates learning
design_response: Use guide character and teacher feedback well
